text:
anya: Quick sync — Datadog + OpenTelemetry tile for GPU Marketplace. Need to finalize tracing tag conventions and onboarding script before partner kickoff next Wed.

sam: SGTM. can we lock the sampling defaults? high-card tags from model_id / prompt_hash are dangerous.

marco: Agree. Proposed defaults: 1% trace sampling for production routes, 100% for dev/test routes. Keep model_id as a tag only on sampled traces.

olivia: Also need a standard attribute name for customer_id across Dedicated/Private so SI dashboards join correctly. Suggest `redwood.customer.id`.

anya: +1 to `redwood.customer.id`. marco — can you paste the small OTEL config snippet we'll ship in the marketplace tile?

marco: Sure — short snippet we tested:
```
exporter:
  otlp:
    endpoint: "https://ingest.redwood-observe.example"
    headers: { "x-api-key": "${REDWOOD_API_KEY}" }
traces:
  sampler: parentbased_traceidratio
  sampling_rate: 0.01
resource_attributes:
  service.name: "redwood-inference"
  redwood.customer.id: "${CUSTOMER_ID}"
```

sam: Can we add a small note about tokenizing PII before it hits traces? customers always ask whether PII lands in spans.

olivia: We'll include a checkbox in the onboarding flow: "sanitize prompts (recommended)" with a link to our prompt-filtering lib. Also need to call out costs for tracing retention in marketplace listing.

eng-monitoring: infra-bot report: we ran a stress test yesterday — additional trace volume with 100% sampling ballooned our DD invoices x4. Recommendation: keep 1% default and provide a cost estimator widget in the tile. :money_with_wings:

anya: Good point. action items: marco -> finalize OTEL snippet + add sanitization note (due EOD Tue). olivia -> add `redwood.customer.id` to marketplace schema and write the billing blurb. sam -> add sampling toggles to the tile UI mock. eng-monitoring -> cost estimator widget prototype.

marco: I'll throw the snippet + a tiny validation script into the tile repo. validation will assert `redwood.customer.id` exists when marketplace mode = dedicated/private.

olivia: For the joint announcement — marketing wants one clear stat: "<X> ms avg latency with Datadog tracing enabled". We should avoid promising numbers; propose we say "observability-ready with low-overhead tracing" and share benchmark appendix instead.

anya: Agreed. No promises in the headline. We'll provide an appendix with testing methodology. Also schedule 30-min dry-run with partner next Tue 10:00am PT.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: marketplace/tile/observability v0.3 deployed to staging at 2026-03-17T14:12:03Z

sam: Nice — I'll grab staging link and circulate to SI leads for feedback.

anya: thanks team — I'll compile notes into a short partner runbook and ping legal for joint announcement checklist. :thumbsup:

marco: FYI — small gotcha: Datadog won't accept keys with newlines in the tile UI, so escape the header value in the docs.

olivia: noted. I'll include a copy-paste friendly example in the docs.

anya: last thing — anyone against adding a one-click "enable tracing" toggle that applies sensible defaults (1% sampling, pii-sanitize on)? seems like low friction for partners.

sam: pro. lowers support load.

eng-monitoring: +1 from ops. We'll surface cost warning modal on first enable.

anya: Great. meeting notes + actions will go into the partnership drive. I'll drop the doc link here after I upload.

olivia: thanks — uploading now. link: https://redwoodhq.slack-files/observability-tile-runbook.pdf

anya: perfect, closing thread.
